summary: community.sops no longer supports Ansible 2.9 to ansible-core 2.14. Users on EOL versions should use community.sops 1.x.
questions: Which community.sops version should I use with ansible-core 2.14?

answer_card.title: community.sops on EOL Ansible
answer_card.answer_md: Current community.sops drops Ansible 2.9 through ansible-core 2.14. Use community.sops 1.x if you're on those versions.
